title: ScriptureRecord
description: v3.0.0 — Canonical reference to a Bible passage with cryptographic content hashing, AI metadata, hermeneutics, cross-references, multi-chain attestations, zero-knowledge proofs, canonical graph traversal, semantic diff, liturgical context, multi-sig governance, recitation metrics, interoperability identifiers, covenant mapping, dispute resolution, and vector embedding index.

record_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this scripture record.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the ScriptureRecord schema.

canonical_verse_count.description: Number of canonical verses this record covers. Must be consistent with the verses field.

content_hash.description: Keccak-256 hash of the NFC-normalized, trimmed UTF-8 text.

hash_algorithm.description: Hash function used to compute content_hash. Default and recommended is keccak256.

revision_history.description: Immutable append-only log of every change to this record.

revised_by.description: DID or EVM address of the revising entity.

zero_knowledge_proof.description: Scripture Commitment Scheme — ZK-friendly structure for proving knowledge of a passage without revealing the text.

circuit_id.description: Identifier of the specific ZK circuit.

public_inputs.description: Public inputs; each a hex uint256.

commitment.description: Pedersen or Poseidon commitment to content_hash.

nullifier.description: Unique per (record_id, prover_address) pair — prevents double-claiming.

canonical_graph.description: BibleFi Canonical Traversal Index — directed acyclic graph of intertextual dependencies enabling topological traversal across the canon.

node_id.description: UUID identifying this node in the canonical graph.

canonical_order.description: Position in the BibleFi canonical sequence (weights: NT fulfillment density × OT prophetic occurrence × cross-reference edge count).

strongly_connected_component.description: SCC index from Tarjan's algorithm applied to the canon graph.

semantic_diff.description: Scripture Semantic Delta Algorithm — tracks meaning divergence between this record and previous revisions or translations using cosine similarity and Jensen-Shannon divergence.

base_record_id.description: The record this is diffed against.

edit_distance_normalized.description: Levenshtein distance normalized by max(len_a, len_b).

liturgical_context.description: Pericope-to-Lectionary Mapping — assigns passages to liturgical calendar positions using a denomination-aware algorithm.

multi_sig_governance.description: Scripture Record Amendment Protocol (SRAP) — multi-signature governance model for proposing and ratifying changes to canonical scripture records on-chain.

recitation_metrics.description: Scripture Phonological Complexity Index (SPCI) — quantifies memorability and recitability based on phonological and structural properties.

rhyme_density.description: Fraction of line-ending words that rhyme with another.

alliteration_score.description: Fraction of consecutive word pairs sharing initial phoneme.

parallelism_score.description: Structural repetition score — high for Hebrew poetry.

phoneme_inventory.description: IPA phonemes present in the passage.

interoperability.description: Cross-protocol linking identifiers to external theological and scholarly systems.

covenant_map.description: Covenant Fulfillment Lattice — models this passage's position within the Redemptive-Historical covenant structure as a partially ordered set (poset).

poset_level.description: Depth in the covenant fulfillment lattice — 0 = Adamic promise, max = final consummation.

dispute_resolution.description: Tracks scholarly or community disputes about the passage's text, translation, or interpretation, with on-chain adjudication references.

embedding_index.description: Stores multiple versioned vector embeddings for semantic search and clustering, with support for dimensionality reduction coordinates.

weight.description: Edge weight for PageRank-style canonical authority scoring.

transitive_closure_depth.description: Pre-computed BFS depth of reachable canonical dependencies.

pagerank_score.description: Canonical authority score derived from weighted PageRank over the full corpus graph.

strongly_connected_component_id.description: Identifier of the Tarjan SCC this node belongs to (cycles indicate circular doctrinal structures — flagged for review).

topological_sort_index.description: Position in the Kahn's-algorithm topological ordering of the full canon DAG.

circuit_id.description: Identifier of the ZK circuit used (e.g., 'biblefi-poseidon-v1').

verification_key_hash.description: Keccak-256 of the serialized verification key.

public_inputs.description: Public inputs to the circuit (e.g., commitment to corpus Merkle root).

commitment.description: Poseidon hash commitment to the record fields used in the circuit.

nullifier.description: Unique nullifier to prevent double-use of a proof in on-chain contexts.

membership_corpus.description: Canonical corpus the membership proof is for.

next_occurrence_iso_date.description: ISO 8601 date of the next scheduled occurrence from reference date.

biblefi_rrule.description: Custom BibleFi Recurrence Rule — extends iCalendar RRULE with liturgical-calendar awareness.

temporal_integrity.description: Tracks content freshness, verification staleness, and temporal drift from authoritative source.

decay_model.description: Algorithm used to compute trust_decay_score over time.

half_life_days.description: For half_life decay model: days until trust_decay_score halves. E.g., 365 = annual refresh cycle.

trust_decay_score.description: Current computed trust score (1.0 = freshly verified, approaches 0.0 over time per decay_model).

is_stale.description: True when trust_decay_score < 0.2 or last_verified_at > verification_interval_days ago.

source_content_hash_at_last_verification.description: content_hash value at time of last verification — diff against current to detect tampering.

drift_detected.description: True if current content_hash differs from source_content_hash_at_last_verification.

verification_authority.description: DID, address, or org name of the verifying authority.

interoperability_links.description: Typed links to related records in other BibleFi schemas and external ontologies.

theological_basis.description: How this scripture informs the DeFi strategy (e.g., stewardship, tithe mechanics).

identifier.description: The passage identifier in that ontology's namespace (e.g., Wikidata Q-number, OSIS ref).

sitz_im_leben.description: The original life-setting / social context in which the oral unit functioned (form-critical analysis).

mnemonic_devices.description: Literary-mnemonic devices detected that aided oral transmission.

syntax_tree_format.description: Normalized syntax tree format identifier for the syntax_tree_ref encoding.

syntax_tree_ref.description: URI to externally stored parse tree (too large for inline storage).

discourse_structure.description: RST (Rhetorical Structure Theory) discourse relation to its immediate textual context.

hapax_legomena.description: Words appearing only once in the entire corpus — critical for translation studies.

morphological_complexity_score.description: Normalized score (0=analytic, 1=highly synthetic/polysynthetic) of the source language morphology.

lexical_alignment.description: Token-level alignment between source language and this translation.
